heading: Bag Theft Offender Apprehended by GRP & RPF Vijayawada
newsTitle: GRP & RPF Vijayawada Arrest Accused; Gold Ornament Worth ₹4.8 Lakh Recovered
newsSummary:
On 05.12.2025, a passenger named Smt. Lakka Raju Vijayalakshmi of Vijayawada lodged a complaint stating that her handbag containing approximately 50 grams of gold (Chandra Haram) worth ₹4,80,000 was stolen at Platform No. 6 of Vijayawada Railway Station on 03.12.2025 while she was waiting for a cab to return to her residence.

Based on the complaint, GRP Vijayawada registered a case in Cr.No. 385/2025 under Section 303(2) BNS and initiated investigation.

Upon receiving the information, Sri J. V. Ramana, SHO/GRP Vijayawada, along with a joint team of GRP Vijayawada, RPF Vijayawada Post, and CIB Vijayawada, conducted a detailed investigation. CCTV footage from Vijayawada Railway Station, Command Control Center, and railway stations between Tenali and Bapatla was analyzed, and intelligence inputs were collected to trace the suspect.

On 12.12.2025 at about 15:00 hrs, the joint team successfully apprehended the accused near Platform No. 1 (South End) of Vijayawada Railway Station.

The accused was identified as:
Bottu Venkata Raja Shekhar (23 years), S/o Rambabu, resident of 4th Ward, Railpet area.

The stolen gold ornament worth ₹4,80,000 was recovered from the accused. He was arrested in the case, and further investigation is in progress.

heading: Stolen Mobile Phones Recovered by GRP Visakhapatnam
newsTitle: GRP Visakhapatnam Recovers 100 Stolen Mobile Phones Worth ₹25 Lakhs Using CEIR
newsSummary:
On 28.08.2025, the Government Railway Police (GRP), Visakhapatnam, successfully traced and recovered 100 stolen mobile phones worth approximately ₹25,00,000, which were reported stolen from running trains, platforms, and waiting halls.

Acting on complaints and under the guidance of DSP (Railways) Sri P. Ramachandra Rao, the operation was carried out under the supervision of CI Sri C. H. Dhanunjaya Naidu. The team included Sub-Inspectors K. T. R. Lakshmi and S. Rama Rao, along with the Visakhapatnam Crime Team (Head Constable L. Udaya Bhaskar and Constables B. Mahesh, G. Durga Prasad, T. J. Varma, Rajesh) and the CPDS Team (RPF), Visakhapatnam.

Using the CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) portal, the stolen mobile phones were blocked and traced. The devices were located across multiple regions including Hyderabad, Guntur, Vijayawada, Kakinada, Rajahmundry, Vizianagaram, and Srikakulam.

All recovered mobile phones were successfully returned to the respective passengers.

This operation highlights the effective use of technology and coordinated efforts of GRP and RPF in addressing mobile theft cases and ensuring passenger satisfaction.

heading: Gold Theft Case Detected by GRP Vijayawada
newsTitle: GRP & RPF Vijayawada Trace Accused in Train Gold Theft Case
newsSummary:
On 16.08.2025 at around 4:00 PM, a passenger named Shri Toriyawala Kujama, a resident of Gujarat, was travelling in Train No. 20626 (Bhagat Ki Koti – Chennai Express) in A1 Coach. Near Vijayawada, an unknown person stole his bag containing valuable gold ornaments. The complaint was reported through Rail Madad.

Based on the complaint, a case was registered on 24.08.2025 at GRP Vijayawada. Upon receiving the information, Sri J. V. Ramana, SHO/GRP Vijayawada, immediately initiated investigation by forming joint teams of GRP and RPF.

Under the supervision of GRP Inspector Sri J. V. Ramana and RPF Inspector Fateh Ali Beg, teams were deployed to verify CCTV footage and interrogate known offenders. Based on CCTV analysis and intelligence gathered by the teams, a suspect was identified as:

Shaik Abdul Rehman (28 years), S/o Shaik Rafi, Resident of 19-7-88, IDP Colony, Sangadigunta, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh.

Search operations were initiated to apprehend the accused. On 28.08.2025, under the leadership of SHO/GRP Vijayawada, further action was taken by the joint GRP and RPF teams to trace and apprehend the accused.

Further investigation is in progress.

heading: Laptop Theft Offender Arrested by GRP Vijayawada
newsTitle: GRP & RPF Vijayawada Arrest Accused in Train Laptop Theft; ₹1.71 Lakh Property Recovered
newsSummary:
On 31.07.2025, a laptop bag theft incident occurred in Train No. 12750 (MTM SF Express) in S3 coach upon arrival at Vijayawada Railway Station. On the same day, the victim reported the theft to GRP Vijayawada regarding a stolen bag containing:

HP Laptop worth ₹1,02,000
ASUS Personal Laptop worth ₹69,000
Cash of ₹350

A case was registered at GRP Vijayawada in Cr.No. 249/2025 under Section 303(2) BNS, and investigation was taken up.

During the course of enquiry, Sri J. V. Ramana, SHO/GRP Vijayawada, led a joint team of GRP and RPF. The team analyzed CCTV footage and gathered human intelligence, which led to the identification of the accused as:

Shaik Abdul Rehman (28 years), S/o Shaik Rafi, Resident of 19-7-88, IPD Colony Road, Sangadigunta, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh.

On 21.08.2025 at around 11:00 hrs, the joint team apprehended the accused near Platform No. 10 (North End) of Vijayawada Railway Station. The stolen laptops worth ₹1,71,000 were successfully recovered.

The accused was arrested in the case and later released under Section 35(2) of BNSS. Further investigation is in progress.

heading: Suspicious Luggage Identified at Vijayawada Station by GRP & RPF
newsTitle: GRP & RPF Vijayawada Detect Unattended Bag with ₹9.7 Lakh Cash Using Dog Squad
newsSummary:
On 22.04.2025, the SHO of GRP Vijayawada, along with the RPF Vijayawada team, conducted a special drive to check suspicious and unattended luggage at Vijayawada Railway Station. The operation was carried out with the assistance of Dog Leo from the RPF Dog Squad.

During the checking at Platform No. 1 clock room, the sniffer dog identified a long-unattended bag. The bag was verified in the presence of mediators, and it was found to contain:

Cash amounting to ₹9,70,200
Approximately 14 grams of gold
Silver items (3 pairs of anklets)

On enquiry, the clock room staff revealed that the bag had been deposited on 10.04.2025 by a person named A. Brahmanandam. However, his mobile phone was found switched off.

The property was seized under cover of panchanama by SHO/GRP Vijayawada, and further legal action has been initiated in Cr.No. 154/2025 under Section 106 BNSS of GRP Vijayawada.

This operation highlights the alertness and effective coordination of GRP and RPF teams in ensuring passenger safety and handling suspicious situations promptly.

heading: Theft Accused Arrested by GRP with Recovery of Stolen Property
newsTitle: Joint GRP & RPF Team Arrests Theft Accused; ₹3.7 Lakh Property Recovered
newsSummary:
As per the orders of Vijayawada Railway DSP Sri G. Ratan Raju, a joint team was formed under the supervision of Bhimavaram Railway Line Circle Inspector Sri S. Somaraju and Tadepalligudem GRP Sub-Inspector Sri P. Apparao, along with staff and RPF personnel.

The team successfully apprehended a theft accused, Ulavalapudi Durga Rao (21 years), S/o Savitri, belonging to Vishwabrahmin community, resident of near Anganwadi School, Singavaram Village, West Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh.

The accused was arrested on 09.04.2025 at around 08:30 hrs near Nidadavolu New Flyover Bridge.

During investigation, stolen property was recovered from the accused, including:

Approximately 30 grams of gold ornaments
18 mobile phones

The total value of the recovered property is estimated at ₹3,70,000. The accused has been taken into custody, and the stolen property was seized in connection with multiple theft cases registered at Tadepalligudem GRP.

The operation demonstrates effective coordination and swift action by GRP and RPF in detecting and solving theft cases.

heading: Major Theft Case Detected by GRP & RPF Vijayawada
newsTitle: Joint Operation by GRP & RPF Leads to Arrest in ₹15.62 Lakh Train Theft Case
newsSummary:
On 13.03.2025, a grave theft case involving a stolen bag was reported near VNEC cabin of BZA Railway Station in Train No. 12738 (S1 Coach, Berth 65). The case was registered at GRP Vijayawada under Cr.No. 98/2025 U/s 303(2) BNS, involving stolen property worth approximately ₹15,65,000.

Immediately, the SHO of GRP Vijayawada formed special joint teams with RPF and initiated an investigation. CCTV footage from the coach was analyzed, leading to the identification of two suspects.

Through continuous intelligence gathering and tracking, the suspects were identified as:

Puchakayala Naresh
Shaik Ahmad
(Both residents of Ravinuthala Mandal, Khammam District)

On 24.03.2025 at around 11:00 hrs, the joint team successfully apprehended both accused from a private hostel in Kukatpally, Hyderabad.

Further investigation led to the recovery of stolen property worth ₹15,62,000. The operation highlights effective coordination between GRP and RPF in solving railway crimes.
